steps.eval: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('.hud, #hud, .hud-root').forEach(e => e.style.display = 'none'); const A = window.__app; A.settings.quality = 'ultra'; A.settings.rayTracing = false; A.view.applySettings(A.settings); const R = A.view.rig; R.update = () => {}; const W = A.session.world; window.__frame = (prefix, dist, height, yaw, pick, tilt) => { const all = W.builder.models.filter(m => m.name.startsWith(prefix)); if (!all.length) return 'none:' + prefix; const m0 = all[Math.min(all.length - 1, pick ?? 0)]; const near = all.filter(m => Math.hypot(m.pos[0] - m0.pos[0], m.pos[2] - m0.pos[2]) < 140); let cx = 0, cy = 0, cz = 0; for (const m of near) { cx += m.pos[0]; cy += m.pos[1]; cz += m.pos[2]; } cx /= near.length; cy /= near.length; cz /= near.length; const a = (yaw ?? 30) * Math.PI / 180; const px = cx + Math.sin(a) * dist, pz = cz - Math.cos(a) * dist; const py = Math.max(W.terrain.heightAt(px, pz) + 3, cy + height); R.camera.position.set(px, py, pz); R.camera.lookAt(cx, cy + (tilt ?? 0), cz); R.camera.updateMatrixWorld(); A.debugTeleport(px + 400, py + 120, pz + 400, 0, 0); return [near.length, Math.round(cx), Math.round(cy), Math.round(cz)]; }; return 1; })()
